It'll be a Saturday, a Sunday, a big stop time. Well, everybody had a chance to go out and have a little fun. And then sometimes if it's a one-stop time and it's not leaving at night, you're leaving that morning. But you can't even know what you're going to want. You know, there's a couple of guys that did it.

And they were lucky that he'd accept them back. Well, there must have been some guys that he probably needed, he couldn't get. Because it was always, like I said, ordinary, simple job, like cleaning up like that, white or black, they'd hide. But they always kept their main crew as people that they could trust. You see? And they always had any man who was black or this white that could do the job that he was supervising and had a choice to tell the guys the guys were to do. The white and the black. And this man, this black woman, they slept on the top deck. She was like a maid. And he was like a, he did most everything. Because they had food on there. That one black man they pick up somewhere for food. And this other black fellow, he raised his farm level and he did most anything he could do. And it was like this guy would work on the deck and wore the uniform suit. And when I first started with that, you just knew what to do. And everybody would go out when they knew the town, you know. Have a little fun, I'll put it that way. You speak to the guys, like, they're working for the people. They're wise in New York, you see. And when you go into town like that, people just looking for you. It's like with the circus, I don't know if you know anything about that. The circus is a part of us who would come into town, everybody's looking for the suckers. You see. So you're well trained to know how to protect yourself.
